notes:
Snapshot: mid-market ecommerce platform w/ fast-growth seasonal spikes. Primary goal: reduce AHT and automate common refunds/cancellations via tool-calls into Zendesk + internal refunds API. POC asks: reliable tool-calling (create/update ticket, attach transcript, trigger refund API), deterministic idempotency so double-charges don't happen, audit trail for PCI/finance, and ability to pause auto-actions and show agent confirmation suggestions.

Key metrics they care about:
- Agent assist latency: suggestions <= 200ms UI render target (prefer <150ms)
- Ticket create/update success >= 99.5% under normal load; graceful degradation under 10x peak traffic (queueing + retry policy)
- Refund automation accuracy: >98% correct mapping to order state; require manual confirm for >$100 refunds initially

Technical constraints / requirements:
- Primary support system: Zendesk (sandbox available), secondary internal refunds service (REST w/ OAuth2), webhook callbacks for status.
- Must support idempotent operations (client-generated idempotency keys) and visible audit logs (immutable) tied to agent user IDs.
- Peak reliability test: simulate Black Friday 5x baseline and 10x bursts for 10 minutes. Expect autoscaling + backpressure to avoid downstream overload.
- Data handling: EU customers must remain in EU region; logs retained for 5 years per finance/legal (they asked about 7-year option).

Quotes / call snippets:
- "If the system can automate 40% of refunds and keep us out of false positives, we'll move fast." — SVP Ops
- "We need to see a demo of tool-calling in a live Zendesk sandbox; can't accept screenshots." — Head of Support Engineering

POC success criteria:
- Live ticket creation from Redwood-generated suggestion with 0% duplicate tickets in 1000 ops test
- Refund tool-call executed and reconciled with internal ledger in sandbox (idempotent twice-run test)
- Performance: median suggestion latency <150ms, 95th <400ms under 5x traffic

Notes on commercial / procurement:
- Budget earmarked in Q2; procurement timeline depends on security sign-off. Potential committed Reserved capacity if SLA measurements look good.

Next steps (short):
- SE to provision Zendesk sandbox integration guide and POC checklist (by 2026-03-10).
- Schedule POC kick-off (target week of 2026-03-15).
- Legal to get draft DPA questions to customer (AE to loop in Legal).
